# How to contribute

## Reporting bugs

If you find a bug, please open an issue with steps to reproduce.
Security issues must be reported privately to the address in SECURITY.md.

## Pull requests

- Keep each pull request small and focused. Unrelated changes should go in
  separate pull requests.
- Run `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` before you push.
- Write clear commit messages.

Large refactors are hard to review. Please discuss them in an issue first.
